confirmed_findings.condition:
(
        `sender_id` IS NOT NULL
        AND TRIM(CAST(`sender_id` AS CHAR))
            REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
        AND CAST(
            TRIM(CAST(`sender_id` AS CHAR))
            AS UNSIGNED
        ) > 0
        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM `bzj_existing_qd_user_ids` AS e
            WHERE e.`user_id` =
                CAST(
                    TRIM(CAST(`sender_id` AS CHAR))
                    AS UNSIGNED

        )
